_xp_doc: XP per source (Progression.award). Kills pay each enemy def's own xp times its infected tier's xp multiplier. loot_container is x the container's tier, clear_poi_per_tier x the POI tier, discover_poi x the POI tier (first time inside), survive_hum x (1 + 0.5 per earlier Hum).
_craft_doc: Crafting pays craft_<recipe category> when listed, else craft: a stone axe teaches more than a twist of cordage. Digging pays nothing (it is unlimited).
